## Compliance (required)

AMMOcoin is built not to be pay-to-play, not an ICO or token sale, and not presented as having a price or a return. See [docs/compliance/](https://github.com/everquin/AMMOcoin/blob/HEAD/docs/compliance/README.md).

- [ ] This change does **not** touch rewards, issuance, the treasury, chain parameters, reserves/tiers, the payment gateway, the explorer, prices/currency, exchanges, privacy claims, or public copy. *(If ticked, the rest may be skipped.)*
- [ ] I ran [docs/compliance/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md](https://github.com/everquin/AMMOcoin/blob/HEAD/docs/compliance/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md) and every red-flag answer is "no" (or an owner-approved exception is recorded in DECISIONS.md).
- [ ] No cash/crypto/goods path to AMMO, no sale or buy-back of AMMO, no purchasable tier position. (AMMO-P-01, P-02, P-07)
- [ ] No AMMO price, market cap or fiat conversion is shown, fetched or derived. (AMMO-P-03)
- [ ] No ROI/APR/APY/yield/passive-income/profit wording or percentage-return figures; rewards in code terms only. (AMMO-P-04)
- [ ] Consensus/issuance changes (if any) are announced and the white paper, website and app match. (AMMO-P-05)
- [ ] Privacy claims are honest; no evasion framing. (AMMO-P-10, P-11)
- [ ] New economic decision? Added to [DECISIONS.md](https://github.com/everquin/AMMOcoin/blob/HEAD/docs/compliance/DECISIONS.md) with enforcement file:line. Contradiction found? Added to *Known gaps*.
- [ ] Reviewed by someone other than the author.
